events.title: Performance Update: Smoother Large Waves
events.summary: Large battles now run more smoothly, with no reduction in enemy counts, effects or visual detail. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46309120/bf8c2c7dd32813f1c4f89e5555bab1a1daa5c848.png RTX 4070 Ti · Identical large-wave stress test. Results vary by hardware. The demo has been updated, and the same improvements are included in the full-game build.

events.title: Demo Update: Choose When Level-Up Cards Appear
events.summary: Hi everyone! A player asked for the option to see upgrade cards immediately on every level-up. That sounded like a useful choice, so it is now available in the demo! New setting: Level-up popups Open Settings → Comfort → Level-up popups: Spaced out · 15 s — the default. Keeps the current interval between automatic upgrade choices. events.title: Demo Update: Clearer Upgrades, Better Readability & More Control
events.summary: Hi everyone! The latest Wildixir demo update is live. I've been working through your feedback, especially the points about distracting particles, hard-to-see XP crystals, and confusing upgrade choices. Thank you for taking the time to explain what wasn't working — it really helps me improve the game. Clearer level-ups Ordinary upgrade choices now grant one level instead of two. events.title: Wildixir Demo Update — Clearer Battles and Refreshed Effects
events.summary: Hey everyone, Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared feedback. This update brings clearer combat visuals and a more obvious way to jump into another run. Reworked ground fire Ground fire now uses uneven clusters of flames instead of a sharp circular outline. events.title: A fresh look for Wildixir — and smoother battles
events.summary: Hi everyone! I've been spending my evenings and weekends giving Wildixir's characters and creatures some extra care. This update brings a lot of visual improvements, a small difficulty adjustment, and performance work for those moments when the screen gets crowded. More personality for our heroes Iva and Rowan have new boots, with better leg movement and a more natural fit. Rowan's sickle has also received a much-needed redesign.
